radiology_report: Prostate volume: 87.5 cc. PSA density: 0.217 ng/mL/cc. PI-RADS: 4. AI model-predicted probability of clinically significant prostate cancer (0–1): 0.7858892.
pathology_report: The patient underwent 2 biopsy sessions. At the first session, Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2, AI model-predicted ISUP 2) was identified in the left peripheral zone (mid); cribriform pattern was present. In the same month, at the second session, Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2, AI model-predicted ISUP 3) was identified in the left peripheral zone (base); no cribriform pattern or intraductal carcinoma were identified. The reported histological growth pattern was: Fusing glandular tubules; Adenocarcinoma.
surgical_pathology_report: The robot-assisted radical prostatectomy specimen showed Gleason 4+3 (ISUP grade group 3), pathological stage pT2c. There was no extraprostatic extension; surgical margins were negative; the seminal vesicles were not invaded; lymphovascular invasion was absent; there was no lymph node metastasis.
